warnings.message: Multi-threaded throughput reached only 25% of 72x the single-thread result. Expected on SMT and on shared-vCPU plans; unexpected on dedicated cores.
`cache_read.multi` varied by 21.8% between repetitions (bound 15%). For memory this usually means a noisy neighbour on the same memory controller rather than a measurement fault.

This machine has 2 NUMA nodes. Threads were placed by the operating system, so the multi-threaded figures include whatever cross-node traffic the default policy produced. They are a fair description of what an unpinned workload gets, not of the hardware's best case.
